title: El Cenizo Holds 22nd Annual Thanksgiving Community Dinner
excerpt: El Cenizo gathered Tuesday evening, Nov. 24, for the 22nd Annual Evening of Giving and Gratitude Thanksgiving Community Dinner. Webb County Treasurer Raul Reyes started the tradition 22 years ago, when he was first elected Mayor of El Cenizo at 21.
content:
El Cenizo gathered Tuesday evening, Nov. 24, for the 22nd Annual Evening of Giving and Gratitude Thanksgiving Community Dinner.

Webb County Treasurer Raul Reyes hosts the dinner, a tradition he started 22 years ago, when he was first elected Mayor of El Cenizo at the age of 21. Families came together to share a warm Thanksgiving meal.

Volunteers served the meal, including the Webb County LULAC Youth Council, El Cenizo Mayor Carina Hernandez, and Webb County Commissioners Juany Valdez and Daisy Perez. Sponsors included Commissioner Jesse Gonzalez, Webb County LULAC, Los Pasteles Bakery, the City of El Cenizo, Fiesta Event Center, El Patio Beer Garden, and Public Management Consulting, LLC.

Reyes said Tuesday evening was his final Thanksgiving serving as Webb County Treasurer. He dedicated the evening to his late mother, marking his first Thanksgiving without her, and said the tradition honors the values she taught him about giving back to the community.
